text:
jamal: Paging spike — customers reporting streaming responses stalling/pausing around token 512. I see a flood of logs with `prefix_cache: miss -> invalidate` and repeated `session_abort: prefix_ttl_expired`. Incident bot created I-2026-34. Can oncall take?
incident-bot: Incident I-2026-34 created (streaming-stalls-prod). Pager triggered for alert StreamingErrorRateHigh. Severity: page. Links: https://incidents/redwood/I-2026-34 :rotating_light:
lucy: on it, grabbing bridge. seeing same in traces, tailing logs now. any obvious traffic spike?
jamal: not traffic. root-causes look like aggressive prefix eviction on a subset of shards (shard-7/8). TTLs for prefix entries were recently lowered in last deploy (PR #4521).
mira: if TTL change is the likely culprit, short mitigation = revert TTL or bump it back. but first we need to quiet the pager — rule is noisy because it counts transient 5xx from reconnects. propose short-term alert tweak + regex filter to drop known synthetic/health messages.
jamal: agreed. here's current log-alert query (Grafana Loki style):
```
{job="runtime", env="prod", service="inference"} |~ "(stream|generate)" | json | status_code
| unwrap status_code | count_over_time(status_code >= 500 [5m]) / count_over_time([5m])
```
Suggested quick patch: exclude healthcheck and synthetic clients and increase threshold window from 5m@5% -> 5m@10% for immediate noise reduction. Also add a signature to ignore `prefix_ttl_expired` where message contains `reconnect=expected`.
mira: draft patch for the alert rule (yaml diff):
```diff
- alert: StreamingErrorRateHigh
- expr: sum(rate(streaming_errors_total[5m])) / sum(rate(streaming_requests_total[5m])) > 0.05
+ alert: StreamingErrorRateHigh
+ expr: sum(rate(streaming_errors_total{source!~"healthcheck|synthetic"}[5m])) / sum(rate(streaming_requests_total{source!~"healthcheck|synthetic"}[5m])) > 0.10
  for: 1m
  labels:
    severity: page
```
jamal: also add a Loki filter to the log-based rule to reduce spam: `|~ "(?i)prefix_ttl_expired" and !~ "synthetic|canary|healthcheck-agent"` — and a regex signature to match the benign reconnect pattern: `prefix_ttl_expired.*reconnect=expected`
lucy: I can apply the alert tweak as an emergency hotfix. tagging @ops-bot to run the rollout. will keep the bridge open 15m after change to confirm reduction.
ops-bot: Rollout started: applying alert manifest patch streaming-alerts.yaml (hotfix). Change ID: hotfix-206789. Expected propagation ~30s.
deploy-bot: Hotpatch deployed to monitoring cluster: streaming-alerts.yaml (hotfix-206789) — verified on 3/3 prometheus replicas.
jamal: mitigation status update: after hotpatch alert volume dropped ~85% and on-call noise reduced. customers still seeing occasional stalls but far fewer pages. next action: bump prefix TTL on shard-7/8 from 30s -> 300s and revert PR #4521 in runtime config. can someone own the change?
mira: I'll open PR to revert TTL and add a config flag gated by canary. PR created: #4589. I'll include tests to assert no rapid evictions under steady load.
jamal: For immediate live mitigation, I've pushed a runtime param change to the config store: `prefix.cache.default_ttl=300` for shards 7,8. Command used: `rdctl config set runtime.prefix.cache.ttl --shards 7,8 300 --env prod --comment "hotfix I-2026-34"` — observed reconnects drop within 40s.
lucy: verified on shard telemetry: eviction_rate down 92%, streaming latency p50 improved ~120ms. Handing off to next oncall at +40m.
sre-runbook-bot: Runbook update suggested: add section "Streaming stalls due to prefix TTL misconfig" with quick commands: revert PR, increase TTL, apply alert suppression, dashboard panels to inspect `prefix_evictions` and `streaming_reconnects`. Responsible: mira (PR), jamal (dashboard).
jamal: Post-incident follow-ups we should track: 1) Create a dashboard panel 'Streaming stalls by shard' (jamal) 2) Add log signature to ignore expected reconnects: regex `prefix_ttl_expired.*reconnect=expected` (mira) 3) Add unit test in runtime to prevent sub-60s TTL regression (mira) 4) Backfill which customer requests were affected and check SLO windows (lucy)
lucy: I'll own customer impact and SLO check. will notify product if any SLO burn.
mira: I'll open PR for the alert rule improvement (longer-term: switch to error budget-aware paging and per-team routing). PR #4592 queued for review.
jamal: small example of the log rule snippet to add into Loki alert panel:
```
{job="runtime", env="prod", service="inference"} |= "prefix_ttl_expired" |~ "reconnect=expected" == false | unwrap shard | count_over_time({} [5m]) by (shard)
```
(note: Loki doesn't support `== false` exactly but we filter with `!~ "reconnect=expected"`)
lucy: marking incident as mitigated in bridge. leaving notes for postmortem doc. thanks everyone for quick responses. :thumbsup:
jamal: final notes for the post-incident tuning ticket: include config diff, alert yaml patch, new dashboard screenshot, and the exact `rdctl` command we ran. we'll schedule a follow-up retro tomorrow. handing off to oncall rotation now.
incident-bot: Incident I-2026-34 status changed to MITIGATED by lucy at 2067894620. Duration: 5m. Follow-ups scheduled: PM-206789 (alert rule improvements), RT-206790 (runbook + config tests).
